proportion_source.reference_note: The six-view sheet is an uncalibrated visual match of the same teal HPEOK PHO-10 oil-receiver family as the source photograph. It is used for topology, port placement, valve orientation and hidden-face inference only; panel scales differ between views and are not treated as measurements.
proportion_source.visible_structure: Upright teal painted steel pressure vessel with torispherical top and bottom heads, upper and lower circumferential weld seams, two circular front sight/plug bosses with red/black indicators, a yellow HPEOK PHO-10 label, a vertical top stainless valve assembly with brass plug, quick-connect on the left and black ribbed knob on the right, a matching bottom drain valve, and a small angled brass/bronze service fitting on the upper-left shoulder.
proportion_source.pixel_ratios: Clean photo foreground is 315 px wide and 1233 px tall; body maximum diameter about 311 px; body (excluding end valves) about 1045 px tall. The candidate uses overall height / body diameter about 3.93 and body height / diameter about 3.30.
proportion_source.label_evidence: Readable source label: HPEOK, 油分离器 / Oil Receiver, Type PHO-10, Inlet/Outlet 3/8" ODF, 3450 kPa 500 psi, CE/PED, 10 L / 3.7 gal, 7 kg, 2018.12.13. The rectified visible label is used as a texture; obscured text is left as photographed rather than invented.

scale.basis: label volume 10 L + clean-photo pixel ratio

body.wall_assumption: closed solid exterior; wall thickness and internal cavity are not modelled

side_ports.note: Port bosses and their indicator dots are visible in the source photo and the six-view sheet; the internal sight-glass construction and thread are inferred.

label.texture_note: Perspective-rectified crop of the visible clean label; lower line blur is preserved, not re-rendered.
